name: rendering-design-docs
title_zh: 设计文档四件套摊成一页，给人看的评审台
tagline_zh: 需求、数据、架构、选型四份 markdown 摊成一页 HTML。评审会上人不用翻文件。
tagline_en: Turn requirements, data, architecture, and stack docs into a single scrollable HTML page. Reviewers see the whole.
desc_en: Use when turning a set of design/requirements documents (requirements.md, data-design.md, architecture-design.md, stack-selection.md, or any domain's equivalent doc set) into a single HTML review page for a human reader — typically to present a review gate. The page is for people only; agents keep consuming the markdown.
why_zh: 它把给 agent 吃的 markdown 原样端给人类，不转述、不总结，只做排版与锚点。
why_en: It serves the exact markdown agents consume, reflowed for human eyes—no summarization, no interpretation. What reviewers see is.
limit_en: Only handles the four-doc set (requirements/data/architecture/stack). Output is static HTML: no filters, comments, or approval flow. Review.
title_en: Four design docs, one HTML review page for humans
